whenToUse: A multi-seller marketplace for independent makers where buyers search, filter and compare sellers.
Platforms where seller reputation (ratings, top-maker badges) drives the purchase.
avoidWhen: A single brand selling its own products — use site-store-01.
Trade buyers ordering in bulk with tiered prices — use site-wholesale-01.
a11y: Result counts are announced through aria-live and filter toggles expose aria-pressed.
Make sure the phone filter sheet returns focus to its trigger when closed.
